product_metadata.title: Gourmet Basics by Mikasa Over the Sink 2 Tier Organizer Dish Drying Rack, 31-Inch, Black
features: CONVENIENT ORGANIZER: 2-tiers of numerous wire frame baskets, hooks, and a built-in paper towel holder. All compartments are removable so you can arrange them to suit your needs.
SIX COMPARTMENTS: Includes two dish racks, paper towel holder, knife/gadget holder, soap/sponge holder and cutting board holder.
SLEEK DESIGN: made of durable carbon steel with a modern black finish
GENEROUSLY SIZED: measures 31 x 12 x 22 inches
EASY CARE: simply wipe clean with a soft, damp cloth
description: Create instant storage space in your kitchen with this Gourmet Basics Over Sink Organizer. Whether you need space to drip-dry dishes and utensils over the sink, or storage for cleaning products in a larger cabinet, this unique organizer is equipped with numerous wire frame baskets to hold your items and keep them in their own space. It features two tiers of baskets, including larger on top and smaller on bottom, side baskets and hooks on the side that can be arranged any way you'd like, and a removable paper towel holder. Best of all, the baskets are removable so you can arrange them to suit your needs. Crafted of durable carbon steel with a sleek black finish, it's also great for use in a bathroom, linen closet, pantry, craft room, or garage workspace. Measures 31 x 12 x 22 inches. Wipe clean with a damp cloth.
